# NYC Tourism + Conventions

> > Official New York City tourism guide featuring top attractions, Broadway shows, hotels, parks, neighborhoods, and local experiences across all five boroughs.

NYC Tourism + Conventions provides comprehensive visitor information for New York City, covering iconic landmarks like Times Square and Central Park, Broadway theater, accommodations, neighborhood guides from Brooklyn to Manhattan, and seasonal activities. The site serves as the official resource for planning trips to NYC with curated photo galleries and attraction guides.

## Key Topics

- NYC Attractions & Landmarks
- Broadway & Performing Arts
- Central Park
- Times Square
- Brooklyn neighborhoods (Bedford-Stuyvesant, Chelsea)
- NYC Parks & Gardens (Brooklyn Botanic Garden, Prospect Park, The High Line)
- Brooklyn Bridge Park
- NYC Hotels & Accommodations
- Coney Island & Beaches
- Staten Island Ferry
- Local Businesses & Shopping
- NYC Events & Festivals
- Outdoor Activities
- Neighborhood Guides

## Essential NYC Attractions & Experiences

- [Top NYC Tourist Attractions](https://www.nyctourism.com/photo-galleries/top-nyc-attractions): Essential NYC attractions: Empire State, Times Square, Broadway & more
- [NYC Broadway and Performing Arts](https://www.nyctourism.com/things-to-do/broadway-and-performing-arts): Broadway & Off-Broadway shows, theater tickets & performing arts guide

## Parks & Outdoor Spaces

- [Top NYC Parks You Should Visit in 2020](https://www.nyctourism.com/photo-galleries/parks-and-gardens): Best NYC parks: Central Park, Brooklyn Bridge Park & Botanic Garden
- [Enjoying the Summer in the City](https://www.nyctourism.com/photo-galleries/summer-in-the-city): Summer activities photo gallery: Coney Island, Brighton Beach & parks

## Hotels & Accommodations

- [Top 10 New NYC Hotels](https://www.nyctourism.com/photo-galleries/10-new-hotels-for-your-next-trip-to-nyc): New & reopened NYC hotels including Arlo Midtown & Graduate Roosevelt
- [Best Hotels in Chelsea, New York City](https://www.nyctourism.com/photo-galleries/chelsea-hotels): Chelsea neighborhood hotel guide featuring Moxy & High Line Hotel

## Optional Resources

- [Official 2018 NYC Holiday Gift Guide](https://www.nyctourism.com/photo-galleries/holiday-gift-guide-2018): 2018 holiday gift guide featuring NYC local products & shopping spots
- [Bedford-Stuyvesant Photo Gallery](https://www.nyctourism.com/photo-galleries/bedford-stuyvesant-photo-gallery): Bedford-Stuyvesant neighborhood photo gallery featuring local businesses
- [Made in Brooklyn](https://www.nyctourism.com/photo-galleries/made-in-brooklyn-nyc-local-products): Brooklyn-made products from local artisans & businesses photo gallery
- [Bushwig Drag Festival Photos](https://www.nyctourism.com/photo-galleries/bushwig-drag-festival): Bushwig drag festival photo gallery showcasing performers & culture
- [Photos from CosPlay & Pride](https://www.nyctourism.com/photo-galleries/cosplay-pride): WorldPride 2019 CosPlay event photos featuring drag performances
